questions.question: Who is currently sitting bottom of the Premier League table today, Saturday 24th Oct 2026?
questions.explanation:
Clue: This historic Northeast club plays its home fixtures at the Stadium of Light and traditionally wears red and white vertical stripes.
Fun Fact: The club's official nickname, the Black Cats, was chosen in a fan vote in 2000, drawing on local folklore and a battery of guns stationed nearby during the Napoleonic Wars.

questions.question: Which former Manchester United and Premier League legend, now turned pundit, celebrates his birthday today?
questions.explanation:
Clue: Bursting onto the scene as a teenager at Everton, this iconic forward went on to become Manchester United's all-time leading goalscorer.
Fun Fact: He scored a sensational hat-trick on his Manchester United debut against Fenerbahçe in the Champions League at just 18 years old.

questions.question: Who is the current manager of Bournemouth?
questions.explanation:
Clue: This German tactician built his reputation in Austria and the Bundesliga, previously managing Borussia Dortmund and RB Leipzig before taking charge on the south coast.
Fun Fact: During his playing career as a defender, he spent nearly a decade at Mainz 05, playing alongside future managerial legends Jurgen Klopp and Thomas Tuchel.

questions.question: Ipswich Town played Nottingham Forest last night (Friday); what was the final score?
questions.explanation:
Clue: Neither side could find a winner under the Friday night lights, leaving both teams with a single point shared in a tight contest.
Fun Fact: Friday night fixtures in top-flight English football became regular television slot features in the Premier League beginning with the 2016–17 broadcast rights agreement.

questions.question: And what is the name of the ground Ipswich Town play their home games at?
questions.explanation:
Clue: This historic venue in Suffolk has been the home of the Tractor Boys since 1884, complete with statues outside commemorating Sir Alf Ramsey and Sir Bobby Robson.
Fun Fact: In addition to football, the stadium hosted England senior international matches and a famous Ed Sheeran concert series in 2019.

questions.question: On this day in Football History, October 24th, 1857 was the Birth of Football: Which Football Club was founded on this exact day and is officially recognized by FIFA as the world's oldest existing football club?
questions.explanation:
Clue: Formed by members of a local cricket club, this pioneer team codified the earliest formal rules of the game in Yorkshire.
Fun Fact: They were awarded the FIFA Order of Merit in 2004 to celebrate their contribution to football history—an honour shared with only one other club: Real Madrid.

questions.question: Tottenham Hotspur legendary forward Son Heung-min wore which squad number?
questions.explanation:
Clue: The South Korean superstar made this single digit iconic in North London, combining with Harry Kane to form the most prolific tandem in Premier League history.
Fun Fact: He became the first Asian player to win the Premier League Golden Boot when he shared the award in the 2021–22 season.

questions.question: Out of the 20 football clubs currently in the Premier League, which one has the biggest seating capacity?
questions.explanation:
Clue: Nicknamed 'The Theatre of Dreams', this famous ground holds over 74,000 spectators and remains the largest club stadium in English football.
Fun Fact: The stadium's iconic Stretford End stand was originally built in 1910 and was one of the last major terrace stands converted to all-seating in the 1990s.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has birthday boy Wayne Rooney won during his playing career?
questions.explanation:
Clue: All of his top-flight winner's medals were secured during a single dominant era under Sir Alex Ferguson between 2006 and 2013.
Fun Fact: He is one of only two players in Premier League history to record over 200 goals and 100 assists in the competition.

questions.question: Who is the top-scoring Welsh player in Premier League history with 109 goals?
questions.explanation:
Clue: This high-flying winger turned central midfielder spent his entire professional career with one club, winning a record 13 Premier League titles.
Fun Fact: He holds the extraordinary record of scoring in 21 consecutive Premier League seasons between 1992–93 and 2012–13.
